notes:
NEW in 0.9.0:
• People — face recognition. Finds faces, clusters them into people you can
  name, People filter on search. Consent-gated: you pick the recognition
  model, then approve a one-time download from Hugging Face; photos never
  leave your machine, and withdrawal never deletes them. Desktop + web.
• Scoped search: `name:` prefix, search inside a folder/subfolder, extension
  filters, per-folder skip lists — CLI, desktop app, and web.
• Rendering fix for NVIDIA cards on Linux — the stale-paint/ghosting chase
  closes with the measured webkit rendering config baked into the app
  (no user env variables needed).
• Settings upgrades: consent explanation, API-access section with minted
  keys + browsable docs, agent-neutral MCP setup copy.
• The README documents People, the MCP server for AI agents, and why the
  face models are downloaded after consent, not packaged.

IMPORTANT — update chain: this is the first release signed with the fork's
own updater key. Desktop installs from 0.8.x (built with the old upstream
key) update by hand ONCE from this release page; installs from 0.9.0 onward
self-update automatically from here on.

Known: in admin-key-only server deployments, starting an index job
(POST /index with the admin key) can crash the API process — fix in
progress, ships in the next release; the desktop app is unaffected.

Install: payload tiles below (server/engine), the Homebrew formula, and the
desktop installers (Windows setup, Linux AppImage, macOS universal) attached
when the Packages build turns green.
